_comment: Curated upcoming US dates (official sources). Shorts and the weekly 'week ahead' video use events inside the next 21 days. Add new rows each month; verify dates on the source site before adding.

events.title: Federal Reserve interest rate decision
events.say: The Federal Reserve wraps up its two day meeting and announces whether it will change interest rates, which affects mortgages, car loans, credit cards and savings rates.

events.title: ACA Marketplace open enrollment begins
events.say: Open enrollment for Affordable Care Act health plans on Healthcare.gov starts, and it runs through January 15 in most states. Compare plans before you pick one.

events.title: Thanksgiving Day
events.say: Many banks, government offices and the stock market are closed, and the market closes early the next day.

events.title: Black Friday
events.say: The biggest shopping day of the season. Compare prices before you buy and watch out for fake deals and scam links.

events.title: Cyber Monday
events.say: Online retailers run big sales. Use a credit card for fraud protection and keep your order confirmations.

events.title: Medicare open enrollment ends
events.say: The last day to change your Medicare Advantage or Part D plan for next year is December 7.

events.title: Federal Reserve interest rate decision
events.say: The Federal Reserve ends its December meeting and announces its decision on interest rates.

events.title: Geminid meteor shower peaks
events.say: One of the best meteor showers of the year peaks the night of December 13 into the 14th. Find a dark spot away from city lights and look up after about 9 p.m.

events.title: Year-end tax deadline
events.say: December 31 is the last day for many moves that count for this tax year, including required minimum distributions from retirement accounts, charitable gifts and spending flexible spending account money if your plan has no extension.

events.title: Leonid meteor shower peaks
events.say: The Leonids peak overnight on November 17 into the 18th, a fast shower best seen after midnight away from city lights.

events.title: Fourth quarter estimated tax payment due
events.say: Self employed people and others who pay estimated taxes have until January 15 to send the final payment for the previous year.

events.title: Veterans Day
events.say: A federal holiday. Banks and federal offices are closed and there is no mail delivery, but the stock market stays open.

events.title: Deadline to enroll for January 1 health coverage
events.say: On Healthcare.gov, December 15 is the usual last day to pick a plan if you want coverage to start on January 1.

events.title: Christmas Day
events.say: Banks, federal offices and the stock market are closed. Order gifts early to avoid late shipping fees.

events.title: Open enrollment ends for most Marketplace health plans
events.say: January 15 is the last day to sign up for a Marketplace plan in most states for coverage that starts February 1.
